title: Destreza Prime
extract:
Destreza Prime is the Primed variant of the  Destreza, featuring overall improved stats and the best critical stats of any rapier, but with slightly slower attack speed. It was released alongside  Limbo Prime and  Pyrana Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Vulpine Mask and  Cunning Aspect (Conclave only) stance.
Innate two  polarities.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Highest critical chance and critical multiplier of all rapiers.

Acquisition

Notes

Incarnon Genesis

Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn  Destreza Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Destreza with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
Purchased from Cavalero for  120, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

Installing the Destreza Prime requires 20  Pathos Clamps, 70  Dracroot, and 60  Rune Marrow.
When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. The following Evolution tiers, their requirements for unlocking them, and their related perks, are shown below;
Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 affinity to the weapon, affected by Affinity Boosters.

Overview
Incarnon Form is charged by building Melee Combo to 6x, then using a Heavy Attack. Once activated, the Incarnon form lasts for 180 seconds.
Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, Incarnon Form is removed upon death.

Evolutions

Trivia
Destreza Prime is the first Prime Rapier to be introduced to the game.
